niosh_heat_safety_tool_2026.authority_scope: heat-index screening and preventive options for outdoor workers

epa_trees_vegetation_2025.title: Using Trees and Vegetation to Reduce Heat Islands
epa_trees_vegetation_2025.authority_scope: urban heat-island mitigation using trees and vegetation

actions.title: Verify operational vulnerability factors
actions.recommendation: Before using an adjusted operational priority, verify physical exertion, acclimatization status, and heat-burdening PPE or clothing for the operation being evaluated.
actions.why_template: Adjusted priority is withheld because verified operational vulnerability evidence is currently unknown.
limitations: This action does not assert that vulnerability factors are present; it requests verification.
No individual medical susceptibility is inferred.

actions.title: Verify protective heat controls
actions.recommendation: Verify whether potable water, shaded or cooled recovery, work-rest controls, and heat training or monitoring are available for any operation being evaluated.
actions.why_template: Evidence-adjusted priority is withheld because verified adaptive-capacity evidence is currently unknown.
limitations: This action does not assert that protective controls are absent; it requests verification.
The appropriate controls depend on the actual activity, workload, PPE, and worksite conditions.

actions.title: Assess shade and recovery options around public-use contexts
actions.recommendation: In this scenario replay, assess whether relevant transit-waiting and outdoor-public locations near the hotspot have suitable shade or cool recovery options before selecting an intervention.
actions.why_template: The ledger records hazard ordinal {hazard_planning_ordinal} with {current_mapped_transit_waiting_objects_within_radius} mapped transit-waiting and {current_mapped_outdoor_public_objects_within_radius} mapped outdoor-public objects within the analysis radius.
limitations: Mapped objects do not establish actual occupancy or footfall.
Historical thermal evidence is being replayed against current mapped context; this is not current heat.

actions.title: Assess tree and vegetation shade feasibility
actions.recommendation: Evaluate whether trees, vegetation, or other shade strategies are feasible at relevant public locations near the replayed hotspot as a long-term heat-island mitigation option.
actions.why_template: The ledger records hazard ordinal {hazard_planning_ordinal} with mapped public-use context nearby: transit={current_mapped_transit_waiting_objects_within_radius}, outdoor_public={current_mapped_outdoor_public_objects_within_radius}, civic_public={current_mapped_civic_public_objects_within_radius}.
limitations: HeatShield does not estimate a site-specific temperature reduction without a validated intervention model.
This is a feasibility assessment, not an instruction to plant or construct at a specific site.

actions.title: Review worker heat practices if operations are present
actions.recommendation: If outdoor or hot-environment work occurs in the affected area, review water access, recovery breaks, scheduling, acclimatization, training, and buddy or monitoring practices before the operation.
actions.why_template: The thermal-hazard planning ordinal is {hazard_planning_ordinal}; if actual outdoor or hot-environment work is confirmed, recognized heat-control practices should be reviewed.
limitations: Current mapped context does not prove that workers are present.
This recommendation activates only as a conditional review until operator scope is verified.
